# iDrinkALot

> iDrinkALot is a drink tracker for nights out. Log drinks as you go, watch an estimated BAC (blood alcohol content) curve update live, see your sober-by time, and run group sessions where friends see each other's drinks in real time. Available as a web app on iPhone and Android (app.idrinkalot.com) and as a Google Play beta.

BAC numbers in iDrinkALot are estimates from the Widmark formula, not medical measurements, and should never be used to decide whether someone can drive.

## Features

- Live BAC curve and sober-by time, recalculated every second, using the Widmark formula with weight, sex, age and a stomach fullness slider
- Shows promille (‰) or BAC %
- Catalog of over 365 drinks plus regional beers (beer, shots, wine, cocktails) with adjustable volume and calorie tracking
- Backdate a forgotten drink up to 4 hours
- Sessions with units, calories, duration, peak BAC, location and per-category goals
- Weekly unit cap and optional water-break reminder when a goal is hit
- Group sessions: invite friends, see everyone's drinks, units and BAC estimate live on one graph
- Add friends by username, eight-character friend code or QR code
- Friends-only feed for posting a finished session with up to four photos; no public profiles, no algorithm
- Drinkdex (how many catalog drinks you've tried), drink and sober streaks, records and charts

## How to get it

- iPhone: open https://app.idrinkalot.com in Safari and use Share > Add to Home Screen. No App Store needed.
- Android: join the Google Play beta at https://idrinkalot.com/#beta, or use the web app like on IOS: https://app.idrinkalot.com.

## Privacy

Drink logs are visible only to the user and the friends they add. Data is not sold or shared with advertisers. Deleting the account removes all data.
